entries.message: On Mac, a Quick Window for a link from another app opens over the window you're in and on its display, instead of over a Crest window that may be on another display, and comes to the Space you're on.
On Mac, a Quick Window that opens where another already is opens a little below and to the right of it, so both stay in view.
On Mac, Command-` (Move focus to next window) moves between Crest's windows, Quick Windows included, when a Chromium page has focus.

On Mac, a link from another app that opens a Quick Window already open for it brings that Quick Window to the window you're in, and Quick Windows opening at a screen's edge no longer open on top of each other.
On Mac, a Quick Window for a link from a window that spans two displays opens on the display you're using and fits on it.
